# v0.7.0 — Worker imports and framework examples

2026-09-11 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.7.0)

## Changes

Dedicated worker imports with cancellation, deadlines and optional repair reports. Added React and Vue examples.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.7.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../worker-imports) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
